from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import (

)

# Import common PyLabRobot resources.
# Note: Specific resources like plates and tip racks are usually defined in the
# hardware configuration and loaded dynamically, not imported directly.
from pylabrobot.resources import Plate, TipRack, Well


async def protocol(lh: LiquidHandler):
    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    This function contains all the liquid handling operations.
    The AI Agent will replace the placeholder below with generated protocol logic.

    Args:
        lh (LiquidHandler): The liquid handler instance for performing operations
    """
    
    # [AGENT_CODE_STUB]
    # =====================================================================
    # ROOT-CAUSE FIX
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ERROR: "ChatterBoxBackend is deprecated. Use

    #
    # The failure occurred at MODULE LEVEL (before this function ever ran):
    #
    #     from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import (
    #         ChatterBoxBackend,   # <-- DEPRECATED, raises on use
    #     )
    #     ...
    #     lh = LiquidHandler(backend=ChatterBoxBackend(), deck_layout=None)

    # REQUIRED CORRECTION (module level, outside this function body):

    #     lh = LiquidHandler(backend=LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend(),

    #
    # This function body additionally avoids the two known simulation
    # pitfalls diagnosed previously:
    #   (1) drop_tips() with no argument -> trash lookup failure
    #       (deck "simple_deck" defines no "trash" resource).
    #       FIX: always pass an explicit location to drop_tips().
    #   (2) aspirate volumes exceeding tip capacity
    #       (tip_rack_50ul / TIP_50ul_L max_volume = 50 uL).
    #       FIX: all transfer volumes are <= 50 uL.
    # =====================================================================

    # ---- Step 1: resolve pre-configured deck resources ----
    print("[PROTOCOL] resolving deck resources...")
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")
    print("[PROTOCOL] all resources resolved OK")

    # ---- Step 2: pick up tips (single tip, explicit location) ----
    print("[PROTOCOL] pick_up_tips(tip_rack['A1'])")
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])

    # ---- Step 3: aspirate within tip capacity (10 uL <= 50 uL max) ----
    print("[PROTOCOL] aspirate(source['A1'], vols=[10])")
    await lh.aspirate(source["A1"], vols=[10])

    # ---- Step 4: dispense to destination ----
    print("[PROTOCOL] dispense(dest['A1'], vols=[10])")
    await lh.dispense(dest["A1"], vols=[10])

    # ---- Step 5: drop tips with EXPLICIT location ----
    # (avoids the default trash-container lookup, which fails on this deck)
    print("[PROTOCOL] drop_tips(tip_rack['A1'])  # explicit location")
    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])

    # ---- Step 6: second transfer using the reagent trough ----
    print("[PROTOCOL] pick_up_tips(tip_rack['B1'])")
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["B1"])

    print("[PROTOCOL] aspirate(trough['A1'], vols=[20])")
    await lh.aspirate(trough["A1"], vols=[20])

    print("[PROTOCOL] dispense(dest['B1'], vols=[20])")
    await lh.dispense(dest["B1"], vols=[20])

    print("[PROTOCOL] drop_tips(tip_rack['B1'])  # explicit location")
    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["B1"])

    print("[PROTOCOL] all liquid-handling operations completed")
    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

async def main():
    """
    Main execution function that sets up the liquid handler and runs the protocol.
    """
    # Initialize the liquid handler with a simulation backend
    lh = LiquidHandler(backend=ChatterBoxBackend(), deck_layout=None)
    
    try:
        # Setup the liquid handler
        await lh.setup()
        
        # Run the protocol
        await protocol(lh)
        
        print("✅ Protocol execution completed successfully!")
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Protocol execution failed: {e}")
        raise
    finally:
        # Always stop the liquid handler to clean up resources
        try:
            await lh.stop()
        except Exception as cleanup_error:
            print(f"⚠️ Warning: Failed to clean up liquid handler: {cleanup_error}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    """
    Entry point for running the protocol.
    """
    print("🚀 Starting PyLabRobot Protocol Execution...")
    asyncio.run(main())
